title: dactylorhiza kerryensis subsp. occidentalis
intro: Dactylorhiza kerryensis subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Kerry marsh orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to Ireland. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Kerry marsh orchid include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Dactylorhiza kerryensis subsp. occidentalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
